title: Polypiler CI layer
description: tooling/ci/layers/<layer>.yaml, written in YAML: one layer of the CI, run by the job 'layer-<layer>' of .github/workflows/ci.yml. 'polypiler-tooling ci audit' also requires 'layer' to equal the file name and every toolchain to be a key of tooling/toolchains.lock.

layer.description: The layer's name: its file name without '.yaml', and the job 'layer-<layer>'.

toolchains.description: The keys of tooling/toolchains.lock the layer installs; the tests of the layer may require these and dotnet-sdk.

os.description: The runner labels the layer's job runs on.

paths.description: Globs of changed repository paths that select the layer: '*' within a segment, '**' any number of whole segments.

always.description: Whether the layer runs whatever changed.
